title: Announcement Bar
description: A slim, full-width notification banner — a short message with an optional link, for the header or the top of a slot. Can be made dismissible by the visitor.

message.title: Message
message.description: Keep it to a line. Markdown: bold, italics and inline links work; headings and lists are flattened.

value.title: Message
value.description: Keep it to a line. Markdown: bold, italics and inline links work.

href.title: Bar link
href.description: Optional. Makes the whole bar a link. Inline links in the message still work on their own.

linkLabel.title: Link text
linkLabel.description: Optional. Shown after the message, e.g. "Shop now". Without it the whole bar is still clickable, announced by the message itself.

dismissible.title: Dismissible
dismissible.description: Show a close (×) button. A dismissed bar stays hidden for that visitor (stored in their browser) until this announcement's message changes.

textColor.title: Text colour
textColor.description: Optional. Defaults to the background colour's contrast colour.

maxWidth.title: Max width
maxWidth.description: Width of the message area; the background always spans the page.

customCss.title: Custom CSS (advanced)
customCss.description: Optional. CSS for this block only — it also reaches any blocks nested inside it. Bare declarations style the block itself (background: …); nested rules style what's inside (h2 { … }, &:hover { … }, @media … { … }); custom properties (--color-primary: …) flow down to child blocks. Leave blank for none.
